dedupe_keys.name: solar active region magnetogram image dataset for studies of space weather

description: Solar active region magnetogram image dataset for studies of space weather is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Laura E. Boucheron et al. In this dataset we provide a collection of line-of-sight (LOS) solar photospheric magnetograms (images quantifying the strength of the photospheric magnetic field) from the National Aeronautics and Space Administration’s (NASA’s) Solar Dynamics Observatory (SDO). Coverage: not stated; published in 2023. Formats: CSV, TXT, Image. The data are held in arXiv and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
